purpose: Prove that Phase-2 knowledge and analytics projections (Fabric knowledge, Copilot Studio surface, analytics) stay DEFERRED until the MVP contracts stabilize, and that graph/ontology expansion never owns workflow state. Three Phase-2 projection plans are catalogued with their triggering stability criteria, each marked phase:2, deferredUntil:'mvp-contracts-stable', and ownsWorkflowState:false. A premature-activation attempt yields a policy-denial receipt and the projection remains deferred. The 4-5 semantic-contract projection slice is cross-referenced (planes are projections only) — referenced, not duplicated. Local contract evidence only; every would-be live plane write appears as a deferred entry naming its receipt gate.

triggeringStabilityCriteria: Epic 2 receipt-backed Work Item state changes (Story 2.3) are tenant-verified and stable
Epic 4 Council Semantic Contract vocabulary (com_graphedgetype / com_graphentitytype) is tenant-verified and frozen for re-projection
Story 4.5 semantic-contract projection slice projectionManifest has been tenant-verified against the live Dataverse semantic model and Fabric IQ ontology without unresolved drift
projectionPlans.planRationale: Fabric IQ ontology becomes a projection surface for Council knowledge once the MVP contracts that define Work Item state, source-record capture, and semantic-contract vocabulary are stable. Until then this plan stays deferred; ontology expansion may only propose terms back to the Council Semantic Contract and never owns workflow state.
projectionPlans.plannedProjectionSurface: Fabric IQ ontology entities/edges projected from council-semantic-contract; no Work Item execution authority
projectionPlans.liveWriteDeferredTo: receipt-gated post mvp-contracts-stable; no tenant write in this slice

triggeringStabilityCriteria: Epic 2 approval boundaries (Story 2.2) are tenant-verified so Copilot surface actions never bypass human approval
Epic 3 handoff/reply drafts (Story 3.3) are tenant-verified for the outbound-action contract the Copilot surface would invoke
Story 4.4 approved-instruction receipts are tenant-verified so the Copilot surface only acts on receipt-backed approved instructions
projectionPlans.planRationale: A Copilot Studio surface becomes the conversational projection of Council Work Items only once the approval-boundary, handoff, and approved-instruction MVP contracts are stable. The surface projects Council state read-only and routes any action through the receipt-gated MVP contracts; it never owns workflow state and never writes directly to Dataverse.
projectionPlans.plannedProjectionSurface: Copilot Studio topic/action projecting Council Work Items and Receipts read-only; outbound actions route through Epic 2/3 receipt gates
projectionPlans.liveWriteDeferredTo: receipt-gated post mvp-contracts-stable; no tenant write in this slice

triggeringStabilityCriteria: Epic 2 idempotent-mutation receipts (Story 2.4) are tenant-verified so analytics can replay receipt-backed state deterministically
Epic 1 source-record and Work Item schemas (Stories 1.1-1.5) are tenant-verified and frozen for analytics modeling
Story 2.6 failure/policy-denial receipts are tenant-verified so analytics can classify denials without inferring state
projectionPlans.planRationale: Analytics over Council receipts and Work Items becomes a Phase-2 projection once the MVP receipt and schema contracts are stable. Analytics is a read-only projection of receipt-backed state; it never owns workflow state and never writes back into Dataverse without a new receipt.
projectionPlans.plannedProjectionSurface: Analytics warehouse projected from receipt-backed Council state; read-only, no write-back authority
projectionPlans.liveWriteDeferredTo: receipt-gated post mvp-contracts-stable; no tenant write in this slice

prematureActivationAttempts.attemptedAction: Activate the Copilot Studio surface projection before the approval-boundary, handoff, and approved-instruction MVP contracts are tenant-verified.
prematureActivationAttempts.denialRationale: The Copilot Studio surface projection is gated by deferredUntil:'mvp-contracts-stable'. The triggering stability criteria for PHASE2-PLAN-LOCAL-002 are not yet tenant-verified, so activating the surface now would let a projection bypass the receipt-gated MVP approval boundaries. A policy_denied receipt is appended and the projection remains deferred; no plane write occurs in this slice.
